correctness.rationale: PASS — For all n>=2, q_i>=1 and r>=1, the center-deletion complex is the join of star higher-independence complexes, each a suspension of an (r−2)-simplex skeleton. This gives the product U_r of binomial ranks in dimension nr−1. With the root present, the link weight is w(F)=sum_{a_i in F}(1+|F∩B_i|)<=r−1. Sequential toggling of distinguished leaves yields exactly binom(Q−1,r−n−1) critical (r−2)-cells and an acyclic matching. The root attaching map from wedge S^{r−2} into wedge S^{nr−1} is null by dimension (n>=2), giving the TWO dimensions in the final formula; zero-binomial and r=1 endpoints give contractibility as asserted. The signed Lefschetz generating function and det(I−zg|U_B)=prod(1−z^ell)/(1−z) justify the rational lower-degree sign/exterior-power action, while join Künneth and graded swaps give the integral higher-degree module. Independent connected-component enumeration and exact reduced Euler values for profiles (4,4),r=3 [U=9,V=1,euler=-8]; (2,3),r=4 [U=0,V=4,euler=-4]; (1,1,1),r=2 and (2,2,2),r=4 match. The inspected verifier additionally checks full link Hasse acyclicity/character traces for ten small branch profiles. This is an all-parameter proof, not extrapolation from examples.
